record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical two-dimensional conformal field theory
record.context_brief: Calabi-Yau to N=2 vertex operator superalgebras
record.original_question: Construct a functor from the category of Calabi-Yau manifolds to the category of N = 2 vertex operator superalgebras such that the Fermat quintic threefold corresponds to the N = 2 vertex operator superalgebra of the Gepner model and such that deformations of Calabi-Yau manifolds correspond to deformations of N = 2 superconformal field theories.

evidence.quote: Problem 8.1. Construct a functor from the category of Calabi-Yau manifolds to the category of N = 2 vertex operator superalgebras such that the Fermat quin- tic threefold corresponds to the N = 2 vertex operator superalgebra for the Gepner model and such that deformations of Calabi-Yau manifolds correspond to deforma- tions of N = 2 superconformal ﬁeld theories.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let CY denote the category whose objects are Calabi–Yau manifolds (compact Kähler manifolds with vanishing first Chern class), with morphisms the holomorphic maps preserving the Calabi–Yau structure, and let VOSA_{N=2} denote the category of N=2 vertex operator superalgebras (vertex superalgebras equipped with an N=2 superconformal structure, i.e. fields T, G^±, J satisfying the N=2 superconformal algebra OPE relations) with the natural notion of homomorphism. 

Construct a functor F : CY → VOSA_{N=2} with the following properties:

(i) The Fermat quintic threefold {[z_0:…:z_4] ∈ ℙ^4 : z_0^5 + z_1^5 + z_2^5 + z_3^5 + z_4^5 = 0} is sent to the N=2 vertex operator superalgebra underlying the Gepner model (3)^{⊗5} (the tensor product of five copies of the N=2 minimal model at level 3, with the appropriate GSO/orbifold projection making total central charge c = 9).

(ii) Deformations of a Calabi–Yau manifold X (i.e. its Kuranishi family of complex/Kähler-class deformations) correspond, via F, to deformations of the associated N=2 superconformal field theory in the moduli space of N=2 SCFTs of central charge c = 3 dim_ℂ X.

In particular, exhibit such a functor explicitly, or prove that no such functor exists.
artifact.category_tag: Vertex operator superalgebras and Calabi-Yau geometry
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of constructing a functor from Calabi–Yau manifolds to N=2 vertex operator superalgebras realizing the Gepner-model correspondence (and matching deformations) remains open. Partial progress exists: the chiral de Rham complex (Malikov–Schechtman–Vaintrob) and the work of Ben-Bassat, Heluani–Zabzine on superconformal structures on generalized Calabi–Yau metric manifolds produce embeddings of the N=2 superconformal vertex algebra into sheaf cohomology of CY manifolds, but a global functor matching the Gepner point and reproducing the full deformation correspondence has not been constructed.

status_evidence.title: Superconformal structures on generalized Calabi-Yau metric manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: An embedding of two commuting copies of the N=2 superconformal vertex algebra is constructed in the space of global sections of the twisted chiral-anti-chiral de Rham complex of a generalized Calabi-Yau metric manifold.
status_evidence.claim: Partial result: N=2 vertex algebra structures can be attached to CY manifolds via the chiral de Rham complex, but a full functor matching Gepner models is not established.

status_evidence.title: supersymmetry and Calabi-Yau manifolds (nLab)
status_evidence.snippet: A Kähler Ricci-flat metric induces an N=2 superconformal structure on the chiral de Rham complex.
status_evidence.claim: Local/sheaf-level constructions exist, supporting that the global categorical functor remains an open problem.
